purpose: Prevent every Structure operation from using the same repository or directory as both source and target.
invariants: Source and target MUST resolve to different locations before any target mutation is allowed.
If source.repository and target.repository resolve to the same repository identity, the operation MUST fail even when their subdirectories differ.
If source.directory and target.directory resolve to the same filesystem directory, the operation MUST fail.
Repository aliases, URL forms, trailing .git suffixes and case differences MUST be normalized before comparison where the repository scheme permits it.
Filesystem paths MUST be expanded and resolved to canonical real paths before comparison.
A symbolic-link or relative-path alias resolving to the same directory counts as the same directory.
There is no override, force flag, confirmation mode or privileged bypass for this invariant.
Failure MUST occur before any file, repository, CW, mapping, plan or generated artifact is written to the target.
The rule applies to Structure Mapper, Planner, Projector export/generation paths, Compare/Conformance outputs and every future Structure writer.

fields.repository: Optional repository locator or repository identity.

location.rule: Each side MUST provide at least one resolvable locator. When both comparable locator types are available, every comparable type must be different.

failure.message: Source and target must never be the same repository or directory.

non_rules: This contract does not infer that two unrelated repository and filesystem locators identify the same place when that equivalence cannot be proven.
This contract does not prohibit parent/child directories merely because they overlap; only proven identity is forbidden by version 1.0.
